svg.title: ClassConnect — Academic platform
svg.desc: The academic support platform for Adamas University: students, mentors and administrators resolving academic cases together, with live notifications and AI study assistance. Portals: Student · Mentor · Admin. Stack: React · Express · PostgreSQL. Real-time: Socket.IO · Web push · BullMQ. Scale: 3 API replicas · Redis · nginx.
